title: Global View
description: The parameter network of every open fit and registered parameter group, and the links that make a fit global.

buttons.label: Load…
buttons.description: Load a parameter network from a GraphML (.gml) file and apply its values, fixed flags and links to the fits.

buttons.label: Save…
buttons.description: Save the current parameter network to a GraphML (.gml) file.

buttons.label: Refresh
buttons.description: Rebuild the network from the current fits and links, and lay it out again. The button to reach for when the picture disagrees with the fits.

sections.label: auto
sections.description: Redraw when a fit or a link changes. Changes are coalesced and the layout only re-runs when the network's shape changed, so a running fit costs nothing here. Untick to refresh by hand.

buttons.label: Link
buttons.description: Link the two selected parameters: the first one selected is the master, the second follows it.

buttons.label: Unlink
buttons.description: Remove the links of the selected parameters (of every parameter, with 'all').

sections.label: all
sections.description: Unlink applies to EVERY parameter in every fit, not just the selection.

buttons.label: Fit view
buttons.description: Fit the graph back into the panel: undoes zoom, pan and any nodes you dragged.

buttons.label: Guide
buttons.description: Walk through the window, one control at a time.
What the Global View shows and how links work.

sections.label: Show
sections.description: Parameter network: every fit with the parameters it owns, and an arrow from each linked parameter to the one it follows. Factor graph: each dataset's likelihood (a square) over the variables it depends on, links resolved -- a parameter shared by two datasets is one variable joined to both, drawn gold, and a follower hangs off its master.

sections.label: Layout
sections.description: Algorithm that places the nodes: kamada_kawai and spring keep linked parameters near each other, shell and spectral expose structure.

sections.label: Node size
sections.description: Radius of a parameter node, in pixels; fits and factors are drawn larger.

sections.label: Spread
sections.description: Spread the network beyond the panel (pan and zoom to read it): how a crowded graph is pulled apart without changing its layout.

sections.label: Connect base
sections.description: Draw a line between every pair of owners -- every fit AND every registered parameter group (ndX, a calculator) -- so a plugin's working model sits with the fits it can be linked to. Visual only: it links nothing.

sections.label: Include fixed
sections.description: Show parameters held fixed; they cannot be fitted but can still be linked. In the factor graph they are evidence: a grey node on the likelihood that reads them.

columns.title: Owner
columns.description: The fit or parameter group that holds the parameter.

columns.title: Parameter
columns.description: The parameter's name in its model.

columns.title: Role
columns.tooltip: master: the first selected, which Link makes the second follow; follower: its value is another parameter's; fixed: held, not fitted; free: fitted.

columns.title: Value
columns.description: Current value; type a new one to change it (not for a follower, whose value is its master's).

columns.title: Fixed
columns.description: Held at its value instead of fitted; tick to fix, untick to fit it.

columns.title: Error
columns.description: The fit's uncertainty estimate of the value, when the fit computed one.

sections.description: The parameters selected in the network: edit value or Fixed here; the first selected is the master Link uses.

columns.title: Row
columns.description: Row number of the parameter; type it into another parameter's Link row to make that one follow this.

columns.title: Owner
columns.description: The fit or parameter group that holds the parameter.

columns.title: Local
columns.tooltip: The local fit of a fit group this parameter belongs to.

columns.title: Parameter
columns.description: The parameter's name in its model.

columns.title: Value
columns.description: Current value; type a new one to change it (not for a follower, whose value is its master's).

columns.title: Fixed
columns.description: Held at its value instead of fitted; tick to fix, untick to fit it.

columns.title: Lo
columns.description: Lower bound, used while Bounds is on.

columns.title: Hi
columns.description: Upper bound, used while Bounds is on.

columns.title: Bounds
columns.description: Whether Lo and Hi constrain the value during the fit.

columns.title: Error
columns.description: The fit's uncertainty estimate of the value, when the fit computed one.

columns.title: Link row
columns.tooltip: Type the Row number of the parameter this one should follow; clear it to unlink.

sections.description: Every parameter of every fit: filter, sort, pick columns, edit values, bounds and links; a click selects the parameter in the network.

sections.label: Shade values
sections.description: Colour Value and Error cells by their magnitude, each column over its own range.

buttons.label: Reload
buttons.description: Reload parameters from all fits and plugins.

buttons.label: Export…
buttons.description: Write the table, as shown, to a CSV file.
